purpose: Map how lolcow, Cow, Milk, Farm, Farmer, Dog/Guard Dog, Moloch, Moon/Cube, Tree, archive, spectacle and extraction vocabulary moves between older internet subculture, Joshua Moon/Kiwi Farms history, Tim's independent symbolic development and later prediction/precedence claims.
core_model: Do not ask only whether two parties used the same symbol. Ask where the symbol entered the culture, how common it was, what relation Tim independently built around it, when a named actor entered that relation, and whether any later statement/event actually tests the earlier relation.

planes.definition: Vocabulary and meanings native to or historically circulating inside the internet scene itself.
planes.use: Explains cultural availability and lowers prediction uniqueness for obvious terms.

planes.definition: Documented public facts about named people, organizations and roles.
examples: Joshua Moon/Null as Kiwi Farms operator
planes.use: Prevents public facts from being mistaken for hidden predictions.

planes.definition: Tim/Potatoverse meanings developed in the project's own symbolic architecture.
planes.use: Tracks genuine project development even when it is not predictive.

planes.definition: A named person is explicitly placed inside an already-existing Timic mechanism before the later candidate event.
planes.example: 2026-07-08 recovery places Josh Moon inside the Farm/Farmers/Dogs/Mud/karmic-debt repair field.
planes.use: Stronger than generic symbolism; weaker than a future-tense prediction.

planes.definition: An earlier timestamped statement specifies a later testable outcome/referent narrowly enough to compare against independent evidence.
planes.example: A pre-event statement that Josh would later say/reveal Moloch, sacrifice, sold-soul or equivalent language, followed by a recovered primary Josh passage.
planes.use: Only this plane can promote the branch toward strict fulfilled-prediction status.

historical_genealogy.name: target-centered documentation
historical_genealogy.description: Early lolcow/Chris Chan archive and forum culture converts a person's public events into persistent, searchable lore.

historical_genealogy.name: Cow and Milk semantics
historical_genealogy.description: Lolcow language explicitly imagines a person as repeatedly harvestable for laughs/reaction; 'milk' is already part of the subculture's conceptual grammar.

historical_genealogy.name: generalized Farm
historical_genealogy.description: The CWCki forum lineage broadens into Kiwi Farms, making agricultural/Farm language part of the public platform identity while the target ecology expands beyond one person.

historical_genealogy.name: Guard Dog ambiguity
historical_genealogy.description: Public/adversarial subculture history includes a Guard Dogs role around Josh Moon, showing that Dog vocabulary can describe protection, patrol or boundary enforcement rather than a fixed moral essence.

historical_genealogy.name: Moloch as wider internet metaphor
historical_genealogy.description: Moloch circulates outside Tim as a religious/literary/systems metaphor for sacrifice, devouring machinery or destructive incentive traps; an archived 2023 MATI/Kiwi-Farms-adjacent user comment shows the word already existed in the surrounding discourse.

historical_genealogy.name: Timic recombination
historical_genealogy.description: Tim's 2026 corpus develops a distinct relation among Moloch, soul/humanity consumption, Farm/enclosure, Milk/Cow/Bull, Farmer/Dog roles, cube/box, Tree of Life/Death or Strife, Mud/debt and Garden/Door repair.

historical_genealogy.name: Josh enters the Timic relation
historical_genealogy.description: Josh Moon is explicitly named inside the Farm/Farmers/Dogs/Mud/karmic-debt repair field before the candidate late-July MATI corridor.

historical_genealogy.name: later Moloch convergence claim
historical_genealogy.description: Tim later associates Josh/MATI with Moloch/sacrifice/sold-soul/government language, but the exact primary Josh passage remains unrecovered.

motif_origin_rules.timic_addition: ethical/extraction model and measurable yield proxies

motif_origin_rules.prediction_rule: score only narrower mechanism or future event
surname match has no foresight weight without explicit bridge
synchronism only unless tied to Josh before later event
bare word insufficient; relation + named referent + time required
can strengthen mechanism specificity but is not a prediction by itself

motif_origin_rules.timic_addition: accumulated relational residue/obligation and repair condition
motif_origin_rules.prediction_rule: use named/date-specific coupling, not generic symbolism

culture_dynamics: person/event -> classification -> thread/archive -> repeated interpretation -> audience memory -> role lock -> fresh reaction -> new archive material
target reaction can become additional Milk when it is recirculated as content
archives preserve evidence but can also preserve obsolete roles after context changes
subcultural vocabulary can migrate into outsiders' critiques and later be mistaken for independent invention
a critic can reuse emic vocabulary while giving it a different moral or systems meaning
named actors can move between protector, operator, archivist, commentator, target and Farmer/Cow-like roles depending relation and time
independence_checks: Was the word already native to the subculture?
Was the named-person relation publicly known before Tim used it?
Was Tim's exact relation independently developed or merely an obvious pun/name association?
Is the earlier source exact, dated and user-originated?
Did the earlier wording contain future tense or a testable consequence?
Is the later event independently recoverable from a primary source?
Are apparently multiple motifs actually correlated outputs of one pre-existing vocabulary?
What mismatches or non-occurrences would falsify the proposed relation?
